prompt: An old-fashioned, cluttered bookbinder's workshop. A large cast-iron book press stands on a heavy workbench. The bench is covered with tools: a bone folder, an awl for piercing holes, and a sharp knife. A hide of leather is partially unrolled next to a tall stack of uncut paper. A glue pot with a brush sits near a roll of linen thread and a curved needle. A guillotine paper cutter is bolted to one end of the bench. A finished leather-bound book with gold tooling rests on a small stool. A sheet of marbled paper is pinned to the wall, next to a clamp and a small hammer. A worn leather apron hangs from a hook. This is a place of traditional craft, so there is no 3D printer or laser engraver. The work is done by hand, so you will not see a digital tablet, a can of spray paint, or a modern plastic binder.
